id: Closure K: 4PL c/d 95% confidence sets by Neyman C(alpha) efficient-score inversion
estimand: True physical 4PL c_j and d_j (unchanged). MAP estimates unchanged; sets are a separate inferential output.
method: core/irt_4pl_score_sets.py: nuisance path from the MAP along the expected-information projection (clipped to the native box), unpenalised efficient score at the empirical 4096-pattern distribution, chi2_1 .95 critical value, union of accepted cells on a 26-point box grid. Sets may be empty, disconnected or the whole box.
scope: N=3000, J=12, registered item design (validation.binary_certification.common.truth), theta~N(0,1), native MAP mirt 1.2.0 GH61 tol1e-4 max_iter500. No generalisation.
development: Pilot seed 202611262001, R=80, items 1/6/12 (validation/evidence/p1_4pl_score/PILOT_dev.json); never confirmation.

gates_per_parameter_type_c_and_d.unconditional_coverage_displayed_set: [.93,.97], dataset-clustered MCSE <= .004; refusals, non-converged fits, errors and empty sets count as non-coverage
gates_per_parameter_type_c_and_d.conditional_coverage_informative: [.93,.97] over sets that are neither whole-box nor empty (whole-box never counted as informative)
gates_per_parameter_type_c_and_d.reported_not_gated: exact T(psi0) coverage, empty-set rate, per-item coverage/whole-box, runtime

certification_unit: Per parameter type (all 12 c; all 12 d). No post hoc item restriction; per-item results reported.
